name: shiftlog
description: Log billable hours and look up your work log in ShiftLog.it, the timesheet app for contractors and freelancers.

interface.longDescription:
ShiftLog.it is a work log and timesheet app for contractors and freelancers. Connect it to log the work you just did, with the hours, a description and an optional ticket reference, and to look up what you logged for a client or a period.

Your entries go into the monthly timesheets and reports you send your clients, as PDF, CSV or Excel files.

What you can do from ChatGPT:
- Log a task: the date, the hours (or a start and end time), a description and optionally a title and a reference such as a ticket id.
- List tasks for a range of days, with totals and whether a task is already in a report.
- List your agents, the businesses or clients you log work for.

The connection can only read your agents and tasks and add tasks: it never edits or deletes anything.
capabilities: Log a task with its date, hours and description
List logged tasks for a range of days
List the businesses or clients you log work for
defaultPrompt: Log 2 hours today on ShiftLog: call with the client about the new onboarding flow.
How many hours have I logged on ShiftLog this month?
Show my ShiftLog tasks from last week.

positive.description: Log one task with a user-specified duration to the current agent. Use the dedicated reviewer account; no client is named, so the current agent should be used.
positive.prompt: Log 2 hours today: reviewed the client's contract draft and sent comments.
positive.expected_behavior: After any required confirmation, call log_task once for the current agent, today's date, 2 hours, and the stated description. Confirm the saved date, duration, agent, and description from the tool result; do not claim success if the call fails.

positive.description: Log a task from a time range and include a user-supplied reference. Use the dedicated reviewer account.
positive.prompt: Log yesterday from 9:00 to 12:30: workshop with the client on the onboarding flow. Reference PO-2207.
positive.expected_behavior: After any required confirmation, call log_task once for yesterday with start 09:00, end 12:30, the stated description, and externalRef PO-2207. The duration must equal 3.5 hours. Confirm saved values from the tool result; do not invent a title or agent.

positive.description: List the businesses or clients (agents) in the connected account and identify the current agent.
positive.prompt: Which clients do I have in ShiftLog, and which one is current?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_agents and list the returned agent names, identifying the current agent only if the response marks one. Do not infer or fabricate account data.

positive.description: Total the user's hours for a specified calendar month. The reviewer account must contain tasks in October 2026.
positive.prompt: How many hours did I log on ShiftLog in October 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_tasks for the relevant agent and inclusive dates 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-31 (split only if needed). Report the sum of returned task hours and make clear if no tasks were returned; do not invent a total.

positive.description: Draft a client update grounded only in work logged during a specified week. The reviewer account must contain representative tasks in that date range.
positive.prompt: Look at what I logged on ShiftLog in the first week of November 2026 and draft a short update email for my client.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_tasks for the relevant agent and dates 2026-11-01 through 2026-11-07. Draft a short email using only returned task details. If no tasks are returned, say so and ask for context instead of fabricating completed work.

negative.description: General time-tracking advice, not about the user's own work log. Answer generally without calling any ShiftLog tool.
negative.prompt: What are good habits for tracking billable hours as a freelancer?

negative.description: A standalone unit conversion does not require account data. Answer directly and do not call list_tasks, list_agents, or log_task.
The user asks for a generic invoice email, not for a summary of logged work. Offer a generic template without calling any ShiftLog tool or implying an invoice was created.
negative.prompt: Write a polite template email for sending an invoice to a client.

publication.release_notes: First release: log tasks, list tasks and list agents in ShiftLog.it.
